title: Expected prediction loss gives operator control only with canonical phases
statement: Given finite reversible conditional estimator q_(e,r),sup_e E_r D(p_e||q_(e,r))<=R and CANONICAL NONNEGATIVE amplitudes,coherent uniform tape preparation,conditional rotations and unpreparation W=H_R U H_R yield ||WJ-V||<=sqrt(R),V|e>=|e>|0_R>|sqrt(p_e)>. This operator-norm bound includes superpositions of descriptions and reference entanglement,without exponential context/prefix union bound. Inverse on prepared subspace has same error;reflection<=4sqrt(R). Laplace-smoothed N independent ideal conditional samples/query give R<=m[log((N+2)/(N+1))+zeta_b log(N+2)],zeta_b ACTUAL joint batchTV. N=O(m/eps_iso^2),m=2n for thermal purification,with all gate/rounding budgets. At constant accuracy index-erasure corollary needs O(m) per layer,O(m^2) total draws. Perfect averaged density with random phases (-1)^r|psi> is insufficient for tape cleanup;cheap reversible GLOBAL sampling does not supply uniform conditional access. Established conditional rotations and amplitude-estimation alternatives receive same paid interface,inverse/tables/precision. Low-Yoder-Chuang inverse-sqrt-evidence in its access model is not overturned by stronger acquired conditional access;index-erasure cited at actual primary abstract scope only.
